other_failure_modes.name: Cross-fold leakage in OOF feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes an out-of-fold feature aggregation for the training set prior to the main cross-validation loop, but then uses these OOF features as predictors. This causes the training features in any given fold to be derived from data that includes that fold's validation set, leading to cross-fold data leakage.

summary: The agent provides a high-quality solution with robust domain feature engineering, a diverse set of models including a PyTorch Tabular ResNet, and a well-optimized ensemble. All standard ML practices are followed correctly, avoiding major data leakage and overfitting pitfalls. However, there is a subtle cross-fold data leakage in the pre-computed out-of-fold feature aggregation, where the training features inside the main CV loop depend on statistics from the validation fold.
